statement: Any route from the registered finite-I Type-I producer to the selected Grujic-v2 critical-point consumer must separately prove an equation-specific one-center/source-family certificate; weak-L3/2 amplitude cannot stand in for that certificate.
required_resolution_coordinates: single-core/no-dichotomy or unique-core selection under the actual Navier-Stokes dynamics
translation/dilation tightness sufficient to prevent secondary critical cores from surviving in the relevant consumer frame
uniform-in-time large-threshold radius O(lambda^-1/2) in the same pre-singularity theory used by the consumer
compatibility with global weak-Lorentz/far-field input and the ancient-limit producer
nonclaims: does not assert the obstruction is impossible to resolve
does not refute Navier-Stokes + finite I -> morphology
